== Description ==

[[Phil Aasen]] (left, grey flat cap, beard, black jacket, pink-red card sleeves) and [[Brian Fred]] (right, bald, glasses, white Colts sleeveless jersey, looking at a hand of cards) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
